title: Customer Invoice report shows a line as Title - Description - Tech story
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is on.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154713 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154713 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a labor line {Line-1} with Title (for example "Replace tie rod"), Description (for example "excessive play") and the tech story (for example "Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned").
  • {Work-order-1} has been completed and invoiced as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  3. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  4. Download the report.
  5. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  6. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
  7. Read the characters between the title and the description, and between the description and the tech story.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: a Customer Invoice file downloads.
  • Step 6: the cell reads exactly the title, the description and the tech story in that order (with the example values "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned").
  • Step 6: no field names appear: no "What are you doing?:", "Why are you doing it?:", "Title:", "Description:" or "Tech Story:", and there is no semicolon anywhere in the cell.
  • Step 7: each join is exactly one space, one hyphen, one space (" - "), with no double space and no other dash.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-R1, S3-R2, S3-R5, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (What reaches QuickBooks), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-008; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R1: “A line's text joins the title, the description and the technician's narrative with a spaced hyphen and no labels: "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".”
  • S3-R2: “The separator is exactly one space, one hyphen-minus, one space.”
  • S3-R5: “The technician's narrative is the third and last segment. It carries no label of any kind, and no semicolon appears anywhere in the line text. The reasoning is in §2.”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given a line with a title, a description and a narrative, when it reaches QuickBooks, then the description reads "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned" with no labels and no semicolons.”
